scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --project apps/imzen --extra dev ruff format apps/imzen
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run --project apps/imzen --extra dev ruff format --check apps/imzen
scripts.lint: uv run --project apps/imzen --extra dev ruff check apps/imzen
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:imzen
scripts.test:imzen: uv run --project apps/imzen --extra dev pytest -q apps/imzen/tests
scripts.test:node: npm test --workspace @zenx/plugin-sdk && npm run build && node --test dist/test/*.test.js
